svg.title: tsrslint vs tsgolint 7.0.2005
svg.desc: Summed over 8 open-source projects · all 61 rules · 4-vCPU Linux machine. Lint time: tsrslint 39.0 s, tsgolint 176.2 s. Peak memory: tsrslint 12.0 GiB, tsgolint 46.7 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrslint 13.68 s, 2.61 GiB; tsgolint 54.25 s, 10.54 GiB. mui-docs: tsrslint 4.09 s, 1.59 GiB; tsgolint 32.14 s, 8.74 GiB. xstate: tsrslint 0.90 s, 498 MiB; tsgolint 2.97 s, 1.09 GiB. webpack: tsrslint 0.99 s, 459 MiB; tsgolint 3.47 s, 1.04 GiB. cal-diy: tsrslint 2.47 s, 1.26 GiB; tsgolint 10.38 s, 4.11 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrslint 5.52 s, 2.28 GiB; tsgolint 23.89 s, 7.60 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrslint 5.32 s, 1.88 GiB; tsgolint 22.22 s, 6.69 GiB. t3code-server: tsrslint 6.03 s, 1.45 GiB; tsgolint 26.91 s, 6.89 GiB. xstate and webpack are in the release build's PGO training set. Median of 3 interleaved runs. Machine: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-26 12:37 UTC; tsrslint commit bb26e2ca28e9d7c151073fefa1b7c92a9b7e699d (PGO dist build); stock tsgolint 7.0.2005 (npm @oxlint-tsgolint/linux-x64).
